svg.title: Vale invites Riju and his uncertain match into the inspection.
svg.desc: The three source records remain separate on the desk as Vale gestures towards Municipal Hall. Riju straightens with surprised pride, Ila watches cautiously, and Cecil hesitates to stamp a merely probable file.
svg.text: Page 4, panel 5 · Eye-level wide reaction shot around the completed demonstration

text.tspan: Vale accepts the Crosswalk as an inspection tool
without accepting its probable match as settled

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
